site_name: 47 Crouch Hall Road, Hornsey, London, N8 8HH
description:
We are proposing a small scale ground floor extension of an existing rear garden extension adjacent to a neighbouring property.

The extension shall be of modest size and height, significanty lower than the existing extension, built up to boundary, and retain the material properties of the existing house (elevation, roof, windows etc).
The extension is proposed to be 2.3m in depth and 2.5m in height on eaves / boundary, while 3.2 at the ridge. 

Internally, the aim is to turn an existing utility and bathroom into a bigger utility room, and move the bathroom into the new proposed extension. 
Inside the main house, the kitchen through which the extension is currently accessed would be relocated to the opposite side and this space would become a reading room with access to the rear boot room/utility/ bathroom and garden.
